context_sources.use: Maker statements and early movement/variant context: flying bridges, Breguet overcoil, diamond endstone, optional shock recorder.

Independent macro photography and finish descriptions: gilt frosted plate, straight-grained steel bridge tops, frosted bases, polished chamfers and pins, 14k rose-gold wheels, black-polished/flame-blued crown wheel.
Variant warning: customer personalization can affect materials, engraving, dials and finishing; shock module is optional.
Maker CAD/catalog identity and downloadable assembly provenance.

variant_notes: The photographed target is the No. 00/18 shock-indicator configuration.
A no-shock variant replaces the module with an engraved plate.
Case versions include steel, rose gold and platinum; case metal does not prove a movement finish change.
Published reporting says client personalization may change materials, engraving, dial and finish, so the evidence is example-specific.
The local CAD includes overlapping setting-spring alternatives; reference photography does not resolve that CAD-state choice.

observations.surface_region: broad top field and engraved perimeter
observations.observation: Warm pink-gilt, fine irregular granular frosting; diffuse broad highlight with brighter engraving cut edges.
observations.confidence: high appearance; alloy, coating and scale unmeasured

observations.surface_region: broad top panels
observations.observation: Fine parallel straight grain oriented with each bridge's long visual sweep.
observations.confidence: high

observations.surface_region: feet, recesses and underside/base surfaces
observations.observation: Matte/frosted steel contrasts with straight-grained top panels.
observations.confidence: high primary bridges; medium smaller shock plates

observations.surface_region: modeled outer chamfers and countersink rims
observations.observation: Smooth mirror-bright bands with continuous white-to-dark reflections; substantially smoother than top fields.
observations.confidence: high

observations.surface_region: narrow inset perimeter line inside bridge bevel
observations.observation: Glossy blue-black decorative border, described by SJX as heat blued; distinct from bevel and sidewall.
observations.confidence: high listed visible bridges; medium hidden/small bridges

observations.surface_region: plate lettering, serial cartouche and monogram cuts
observations.observation: Recessed cuts with dark interior/shadow and bright cut edges; bridge cuts interrupt the straight grain.
observations.confidence: high; preserve geometry where present and do not invent absent text

observations.surface_region: lid/top, drum wall and toothed rim
observations.observation: Warm rose-gold broad faces with fine radial/circular satin; darker drum sides and brighter rim/tooth edges.
observations.confidence: high family/direction; medium exact lid-versus-drum split

observations.surface_region: wheel plates, spokes, rims and teeth
observations.observation: Prominent train/display wheels are warm rose/yellow gold, with fine satin faces, linear spoke grain, and brighter rim/tooth tips. Small mixed/source-uncertain IDs need individual review.
observations.confidence: high prominent gold wheels; medium exhaustive listed assignment

observations.surface_region: Steel 249 annulus and 251 main cap; blue cone is 251 face 22, resolved by the subsequent CAD face audit
observations.observation: Two-tone black-polished steel wheel with saturated flame-blued ring.
observations.confidence: high; a single whole-definition ratchet material is incomplete

observations.surface_region: broad face and tooth edge
observations.observation: Cool steel with circular/radial satin and brighter tooth edges.
observations.confidence: medium

observations.surface_region: pinion leaves, arbors and exposed tips
observations.observation: Cool polished steel with bright tips and dark reflective flanks; no coarse visible grain.
observations.confidence: medium due to partial occlusion

observations.surface_region: rim/arms, eccentric masses and staff
observations.observation: Balance rim reads warm rose/copper in photos with bright beveled edges; eccentric masses read warmer yellow gold and polished.
observations.confidence: medium; reflected plate color may warm the rim, so recheck d_0_1_1_110 without asserting alloy

observations.surface_region: Breguet overcoil hairspring
observations.observation: Deep navy blued steel with narrow cyan/amber reflections and no visible coarse texture.
observations.confidence: high appearance; optical constants unmeasured

observations.surface_region: photographed movement placements of screw heads
observations.observation: Heat-blue heads with dark slots and narrow bright/cyan chamfer reflections; color varies strongly with angle.
observations.confidence: high visible placements; not universal per shared definition, especially d_0_1_1_9 and d_0_1_1_181

instance_evidence.identification: upper/left of the two bright steel crown-wheel-cap screws in REF-SJX-02
lower/right of the two bright steel crown-wheel-cap screws in REF-SJX-02
bright steel screw retaining the click in REF-SJX-02
small bright steel right-side/click-plate fastener in REF-SJX-02; same definition has other placements
outer polished steel fastener; medium-confidence photo correlation

observations.surface_region: head top, slot and chamfer
observations.observation: Steel screws and fasteners are circularly finished or mirror/black polished with crisp slots; photographs disprove a universal blue-screw rule.
observations.confidence: high for instances 83_77, 83_82, 83_81 and 83_78; medium for 83_33 and exhaustive ID coverage

observations.surface_region: exposed rounded pin/stud ends
observations.observation: Steel pins are neutral mirror-polished with compact white highlights; ms-marked pins are warm brass/gold in the maker shock render.
observations.confidence: high family split

observations.surface_region: bearing stone body and pivot opening
observations.observation: Transparent/translucent magenta-red stones with bright curved reflections, dark internal depth and visible metal pivots.
observations.confidence: high; opaque magenta plastic is inconsistent with evidence

observations.surface_region: metal setting face and polished rim
observations.observation: Warm gold/rose-gold settings with smooth polished rims and strong highlights around transparent stones.

observations.surface_region: balance endstone
observations.observation: Clear brilliant-cut diamond with high-contrast faceted reflections in a polished warm-gold chaton.
observations.confidence: high visual evidence; local CAD definition is empty, so no source geometry can render it

observations.surface_region: assembled and hidden exploded module surfaces
observations.observation: Mixed straight-grained/polished steel, blue hands and springs, ruby-red gauge inlays, polished pins and cylindrical ruby mass.
observations.confidence: high visible families; medium hidden surface treatment

implementation_constraints: Assembly manifest definition IDs identify parts, not separately addressable faces.
Surface-region observations require topology/orientation evidence or reversible face-specific overrides.
Shared definitions can require instance-specific finishes; d_0_1_1_9 is the known screw example.
Do not infer alloy or process solely from photographic color.
Do not derive absolute color, roughness, anisotropy, bump strength or texture scale from these images.
Do not silently create geometry for the empty d_0_1_1_225 diamond definition.
